row.task_instruction: Analyze the classification performance of different digital modulation schemes (BPSK, 4QAM, 8PSK, and 16QAM) across various signal-to-noise ratios using a pre-computed confusion matrix from automatic modulation classification results. The input should be a confusion matrix file named "pred_confusion_mat_L100.npy" located in one of the benchmark directories for Automatic-Modulation-Classification experiments (such as benchmark/datasets/Automatic-Modulation-Classification/Part4_CNN based AMC/Some Result/train num/train num 100000x4/ or benchmark/datasets/Automatic-Modulation-Classification/Part6_CNN with Transfer Learning on AMC/ subdirectories). Extract the per-class classification accuracy for each modulation type at SNR levels ranging from -10 dB to 20 dB in 2 dB increments, and generate a performance visualization plot showing accuracy (Pc) versus Es/No in dB for all four modulation schemes. Save the resulting plot as "pred_results/pred_plot_every_class.png" in PNG format with appropriate legends, grid lines, and axis labels.

row.task_instruction: Perform single-point energy calculations on selected molecular structures from a molecular dynamics trajectory file. Use the trajectory file "benchmark/datasets/I-ReaxFF/test/md.traj" as input, which contains atomic configurations from a molecular dynamics simulation. Calculate the total energy for each specified structure using density functional theory with GGA-PBE exchange-correlation functional and split-valence basis sets. For each structure, compute the density based on atomic masses and unit cell volume, then perform the energy calculation while maintaining the atomic positions fixed. Save the calculated structures with their energies to "pred_results/pred_singlepoint_results.traj" in ASE trajectory format, and log the structure ID, density, and energy values to "pred_results/pred_singlepoint_density.log" with columns for Crystal_id, Density, and Energy.

row.task_instruction: Analyze the automatic modulation classification performance by processing the confusion matrix data from "pred_confusion_mat_L100.npy" to compute classification accuracy across different signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) levels. Calculate the overall classification accuracy for each SNR point ranging from -10 dB to 20 dB in 2 dB increments by extracting the diagonal elements from the confusion matrices and normalizing by the total number of samples. Generate a line plot showing the relationship between SNR (EsNo in dB) and classification probability (Pc), and save the visualization as "pred_results/pred_plot_acc_L100.png" in PNG format. Additionally, save the numerical results containing the SNR values and corresponding accuracy values to "pred_results/pred_plot_acc.txt" as a text file.

row.task_instruction: Analyze the classification performance of an automatic modulation classification (AMC) system by loading confusion matrix data from 'pred_confusion_mat_L100.npy' and computing classification accuracy across different signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) levels. Calculate the overall classification accuracy for each SNR point ranging from -10 dB to 20 dB in 2 dB increments by extracting the diagonal elements from the confusion matrices and normalizing by the total number of samples. Generate a performance plot showing accuracy versus SNR and save it as 'pred_results/pred_plot_acc_L100.png', and export the numerical results (SNR values and corresponding accuracies) to 'pred_results/pred_plot_acc.txt' in a two-row format.
